tool.name: Vidcomic – Video
tool.description: Create video clips with the connected providers, play them and edit them with ffmpeg.
tool.long_description: Creates clips with the video providers connected in OmniWrench (Gemini Veo, OpenAI, xAI, Runway, Luma, Seedance, MiniMax, fal.ai, Replicate and more), optionally from a start image. Clips are played inside OmniWrench and can be edited with ffmpeg: trim, convert to GIF, remove sound, add music, save a still. On Windows OmniWrench downloads ffmpeg on request (once for Groovitron and Vidcomic).
img.need_prompt: Please describe what the image should show first.
ffmpeg.missing: {kind} needs ffmpeg (thumbnails, trimming, converting, adding music). ffmpeg is a free program (LGPL/GPL) and is not bundled.

{cmd}
ffmpeg.download_q:
Download ffmpeg (Windows, 64-bit, GPL build) and store it in the shared AI folder of OmniWrench? Groovitron and Vidcomic use the same copy.

Source: {url}
video.no_bot: No provider for video is connected yet. Videos can be created with e.g. Google Gemini (Omni Flash), xAI, MiniMax (Hailuo), Runway, Luma, BytePlus Seedance, fal.ai and Replicate. Kling directly is not supported yet (use it via fal.ai or Replicate). Set up connections under Settings > AI assistants.
video.prompt_hint: What should happen in the video? Scene, camera, light, style …
video.working: {name} is creating the video – this can take a few minutes …
video.cost_hint: Videos are usually the most expensive kind (billed per second). The description is sent to the provider without pseudonymization; videos are stored unencrypted in the video folder of the AI data storage.
